thread: mohit_s: heads up — EU prefix cache hit for convo prefixes dropped from ~78% -> 42% after yesterday's kernel selector rollout. noticed higher tail latency in canary dashboards :frowning:
thread_2: alice_k: omg. saw spikes too. can you paste a quick perf diff and sample keys?
thread_3: mohit_s: perf diff: median latency +3.1%, p95 +6.8% for small-gen model (redwood-small-q4). attach: https://remotestorage/ci/18299/eu-cache-report.png
thread_4: dina_p: do we think it's kernel selection path choosing larger GEMM kernels causing KV lookup slowdown?
thread_5: mohit_s: maybe. the new selector favors fused-attn kernels for seq_len>256 but our EU traffic has a lot of short convo prefixes and the kernel switch adds extra memops. also saw increased KV miss penalty due to changed key normalization order.
thread_6: zach_r: hint — when kernels change alignment/tiling we sometimes alter tokenization normalization (lowercasing vs. unicode-normalize) order in the preproc path. that can change cache keys subtly.
thread_7: mohit_s: confirmed. found a one-line reorder in preproc: we used to normalize -> strip -> join; new path does strip -> normalize -> join. different canonicalization produced different cache keys for ~9% of prefixes.
thread_8: alice_k: ugh. can we fix keying and also add a compatibility layer to treat old-prefix variants as equivalent?
thread_9: mohit_s: plan: 1) patch preproc to restore canonicalization order (hotfix) 2) implement a cache-key fallback that attempts normalized variant if primary miss 3) rollout kernel-selector rollback to canary if hotfix doesn't restore hit-rate
thread_10: samir: fallback idea — do a two-tier cache lookup: exact-key -> normalized-key -> prefix-trie fallback. normalized-key lookup is cheap and could recover hits without full warmup.
thread_11:
dina_p: testing locally. here's a microbench snippet I ran (bash):

```
> python -m perf_runner --keys sample_prefixes.txt --lookup-strategy exact,normalized --iters 1000
```
Results: normalized fallback recovered 6.4% hit-rate and reduced average KV latency by 12ms on my host.

thread_15: mohit_s: agreed. sketching rollout: patch preproc -> canary in EU (5%) with normalized fallback enabled -> observe cache hit & p95 for 6 hours -> if hit-rate <70% then enable cross-region failover (5% first) -> measure business metrics.
